name: Keep templates declarative and accessible
statement: Keep Angular templates declarative: use semantic elements, explicit labels, track repeated rows, avoid method calls with work or side effects, and move complex expressions into typed computed state.
rationale: Declarative templates make behavior and accessibility reviewable while avoiding repeated work during change detection and unstable list rendering.

badExample.description: A clickable div and repeated work in the template

history.change: Initial template-hygiene rule based on the signal-driven Quality Studio browser components.
